page.title: Invoice Settings
page.description: Configure tax, currency and email behaviour for generated invoices, manage the invoice PDF & email templates, and set the country tax details injected into those templates.

general.title: General
general.description: Tax and currency defaults applied when an invoice is generated.

taxRate.label: Default tax rate (%)
taxRate.hint: Applied to invoice totals when no per-plan tax is set.

taxIncluded.label: Prices include tax
taxIncluded.hint: When on, listed prices are treated as tax-inclusive.

sendEmail.label: Send invoice email automatically
sendEmail.hint: Email the generated invoice PDF to the learner when a payment is completed.

pdfPlacement.label: Invoice PDF delivery
pdfPlacement.hint: Choose which email carries the invoice PDF after a successful payment. "Payment confirmation email" sends a single combined mail instead of a separate invoice email.
pdfPlacement.optionAttach: Attach to payment confirmation email (single email)

adminCopy.label: Send copy to admins
adminCopy.hint: Whenever a payment completes, the selected admins also receive the invoice / payment confirmation email (including the invoice PDF).

proforma.label: Issue unpaid invoices as proforma
proforma.hint: An invoice raised before payment is issued as a proforma, numbered from a separate series. The real invoice number is allocated only when it is paid, so a proforma that is cancelled or never paid leaves no gap in your invoice series.
proforma.warningPrefix: Invoices already issued keep their current numbers. Proformas are numbered
proforma.usingProDocType: using PRO as the document type
proforma.warningSuffix: and are renumbered into your invoice series on payment.

manualEnroll.label: Generate invoice on manual / bulk enrollment
manualEnroll.hint: When an admin enrolls learners manually or in bulk (no payment gateway), generate an invoice for them.

tax.title: Country & Tax Details
tax.description: The operating country, your tax registration number and its tax components. These are injectable into invoice templates.

hsnSac.label: HSN / SAC code
hsnSac.hint: SAC for services (e.g. courses); HSN for goods.

components.label: Tax components
components.empty: No tax components configured. Add one (e.g. CGST 9%, SGST 9%) or pick a country above to load suggested defaults.

byPackageType.label: Tax components by package type
byPackageType.description: Override the default components for a specific package type. At invoice time, each line item uses its package type's components, falling back to the default set above.
byPackageType.emptyOverride: No override for {{packageType}} — the default components above will apply.
